basic_info.description: Welcome to 1915 Laguna #4. This charming 1 bed / 1 bath is nestled in the heart of Lower Pacific Heights and central to all parts of San Francisco. The unit has upside potential of converting into a 2 bedroom unit. Top floor unit that's tucked in the rear of the building gives this layout privacy and makes street noise a non-issue. The building has a bonus ground-floor common area that offers additional storage options or the possibility of game room/flex space conversion alongside the shared laundry with another unit. Within a short walk, you'll find yourself on Fillmore street where residents will enjoy a vibrant mix of dining options, boutique shopping and convenient public transportation. The building's charming period details provide an excellent foundation for modernization. Tandem parking space included with the unit! You have to tour this property to see the possibilities as an owner occupant or investor!
